title: API versioning and compatibility
description: Learn about API versioning and compatibility. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **API versioning and compatibility** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with api versioning and compatibility.

items: Understand the fundamental principles of api versioning and compatibility
Learn practical applications and use cases
Identify common pitfalls and how to avoid them
Apply best practices in your daily work

data.text: Understanding api versioning and compatibility is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: When working with api versioning and compatibility, always consider the trade-offs. The right approach depends on your specific context, team expertise, and system requirements.
